methods.trace_eia: 2024: proportional sharing (full mixing) on EIA Natural Gas Annual 2024 state-to-state movements
methods.trace_aeo_additive_balanced: model years: 2024 network; production indexed to AEO2026 (Tables 59/60); interregional bundles and Canada arcs = 2024 + (Table 64 level(y) - level(2025)), floored at 0; intra-region arcs, GOM and intra-Texas arcs then rebalanced (least L1 change) so no hub ships more than it has and each keeps its AEO-grown local disposition where the network allows
methods.sensitivity: zone_basin_shares_sensitivity_ratio.csv: the same with ratio scaling (2024 x Table 64(y)/(2025))

known_limitations.text: Each production area (Texas RRC district, NM East/West, LA North/South, a state) is labelled whole with its main basin. Non-shale gas in an area keeps the area's label.

quantified.note: Only RRC Districts 1, 2, 4 move gas between basins (conventional Gulf Coast gas labelled Eagle Ford instead of Barnett/other TX). Districts 3, 7B, 8A, 10 are >30% non-shale but their non-shale gas is in the labelled basin. Source: EIA proved reserves YE2024 Tables 8 and 9; outputs/district_basin_mixing.csv.

known_limitations.text: Colorado San Juan share from AEO2026 HSM producing-project first-year volumes (model-based, EIA); observed county production (ECMC) not reachable from cloud sessions.
Gas is fully mixed at each hub; contract paths and displacement ignored.
Texas sub-hub routing is an assumption (NGMM border mapping, least-flow intra-Texas transfers on NGMM 2023 capacities).
Projected arcs are scaled and rebalanced, not solved by a network model; Stage 2 replaces them.
